title: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: For this part , you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay titled“Are people becoming addicted to technology?”.The statement given below is for your reference. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words. Numerous studies claim that addiction to technology is real and it has the same effect on the brain as drug addiction.
reference: Are people becoming addicted to technology? My answer is a definite yes. As numerous studies claim that addiction to technology is real, this problem deserves our serious attention. Signs of such addiction are everywhere in daily life. Many people check their smartphones the moment they wake up and keep scrolling short videos until midnight. While technology is designed to make life easier, an increasing number of us feel anxious once we are separated from our screens. As a result, real conversations, sleep and study are all disturbed, which shows that our reliance has quietly turned into dependence. In my view, therefore, people are indeed getting hooked on technology. However, this does not mean we should abandon it. What matters is to use technology in a rational way, setting limits on screen time and leaving room for the real world.
keyPoints: 开门见山表态到位。首句直接回应标题问句、用 My answer is a definite yes 亮立场，落实 了‘开门见山表态’；再借 As numerous studies claim ... 化用参考素材引出话题，避免了整段照抄。
现象分析两不缺。先用 check their smartphones the moment they wake up 等具体画面 摆现象，再用 While ... 让步转折、As a result ... which shows that ... 因果回扣，完整走了‘现象—分析 —回扣’三步，没停在罗列现象。
重申加建议收束。用 people are indeed getting hooked 换词重申立场，再以 However ... what matters is to ... 退一步给出设屏幕时间上限的建议，落实了‘重申＋落地建议’，首尾呼应。
